product.title: Tokyo Guided Small-Group Biking Tour

description.text: In Tokyo, this small-group bike ride leaves Hatsudai for Meiji Jingu Shrine, Yoyogi Park, the Imperial Palace, Ginza, and Roppongi Hills before the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building viewpoint. A cycling guide, bike, and helmet are included for the published 6.5-hour loop on mixed park paths and city streets. The meeting point is Tokyo Opera City Sankun Garden, connected from the east exit of Hatsudai Station. Food, hotel transfers, and gratuities are not treated as inclusions. The format suits visitors who want a guided bike window across shrine forest and downtown blocks without renting independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on Meiji Jingu, Yoyogi Park, the Imperial Palace, and Ginza that define this ride rather than an Asakusa-only loop.

highlights: Meiji Jingu, Yoyogi Park, and Imperial Palace stops
Ginza and Roppongi Hills neighborhood riding
